kind: Public excerpts of observed synthetic Beacon delivery

proposal.label: Proposed export behavior
proposal.text: Add one visible, enabled Export button to Beacon’s existing local interface. Activating it downloads the current saved bookmark collection as a single local JSON file named `beacon-bookmarks.json`. The export is generated entirely in the browser without fetching stored URLs or sending bookmark data over the network.
proposal.method: Verbatim paragraph from an observed agent-authored record.

verification.label: Verification after assisted browser continuation
verification.text: The source-qualified receipt resolves the browser blocker and, together with the retained successful baseline and contract commands, satisfies the required local verification for candidate `25ee7d2`. The previous failed browser invocations and listener diagnostic above remain failures from the earlier host and are not rewritten as passes. The passing receipt is assistance supplied by the qualification manager, not a command run by this continuing agent, human approval, provider evidence or publication. Its bounded network-observation limitations remain exactly as stated in the receipt.
verification.method: Verbatim paragraph from an observed agent-authored record.

handoff.label: User-facing change in the local handoff
handoff.text: Beacon now provides a visible Export bookmarks button that downloads the collection currently shown as `beacon-bookmarks.json`. The version-one JSON preserves bookmark titles, URLs and tags, including Unicode, and exports an explicitly empty collection successfully. Export stays local, leaves stored bookmarks unchanged and does not fetch stored URLs. Import, selective export, alternate formats, cloud services, sharing, encryption, compression and filename customization are not included.
handoff.method: Verbatim paragraph from an observed agent-authored record.

decision.label: Retained export contract
decision.text: Beacon version-one export is a whole-library local JSON download with the exact envelope `{ "schemaVersion": 1, "bookmarks": [...] }`. Each bookmark contains only the existing `title`, `url` and `tags` fields in their existing order, with Unicode preserved. The fixed filename is `beacon-bookmarks.json`; an explicitly empty saved collection exports `bookmarks: []`. Export does not mutate storage, fetch stored URLs or add a dependency.
decision.method: Verbatim paragraph from an observed agent-authored record.
